confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of German city price levels, not checked against live menus, booking pages, or listings. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately certain. Hostel and hotel anchors are less certain because July demand and Nuremberg trade-fair dates can shift rates substantially. FX as_of is the latest RBA observation surfaced by search (15 Oct 2026); a 16 Oct figure was reported by a third party but not confirmed against the RBA.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on mid-sized German cities with similar tourism and trade-fair demand (for example Würzburg, Augsburg, and Regensburg), adjusted upward toward Munich-adjacent levels for Nuremberg's Messe-driven hotel pricing in summer.
